risks.title: Customer concentration and credit risk
risks.score_rationale: This risk is identified as the first major risk factor. The example of Genesis bankruptcy (7.3% of revenues in 2025) demonstrates material impact. Increased allowance for doubtful accounts ($83.1M in 2025) indicates elevated risk. Strong language ('material adverse effect') underscores severity.

risks.title: Macroeconomic conditions and inflation impact
risks.score_rationale: This is the first macroeconomic risk identified in the report. Language intensity ('adversely affected', 'material adverse effect') is high. Mitigation actions do not guarantee full cost recovery compensation.

risks.title: Healthcare industry regulatory risks
risks.score_rationale: Detailed under customer dependency risks. HCSG's customer base is directly dependent on healthcare regulations. Language intensity ('significantly altered', 'adversely affect') is elevated. Heavy reliance on Medicare/Medicaid reimbursement justifies severity.

risks.title: Labor cost increases and wage pressures
risks.score_rationale: Addressed in macroeconomic section. EVS labor represents 78.3% of EVS revenue, Dietary labor 58.8% of Dietary revenue. Minimum wage increases and collective bargaining impacts are material. Language includes 'material adverse effect'.

risks.title: Pandemic and contagious disease risks
risks.score_rationale: Clearly identified risk factor. Multiple impacts possible (supply availability, personnel, operations). Strong language ('material adverse effect') and historical precedent justify severity of 3.

risks.title: Financial market volatility and interest rate risk
risks.score_rationale: Addressed in macroeconomic section with specific mention of interest rate changes and market volatility. Language ('fluctuating and even negative returns', 'adversely impact') supports moderate severity. Impact on borrowing costs and investments relevant.

risks.title: Key supplier concentration
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in macroeconomic section regarding limited EVS and Dietary suppliers. While impact has not been material to date, Sysco dependency for over 50% of food supplies represents concentration risk.

ai_positioning.summary: The company HCSG does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
